correctness.rationale: For θ>−1/2 the CRP has positive probabilities on the stated support. Iterating its recurrence factors the probabilities into the half-discount coefficients and the block-creation weights. The exponential block series is 2(1−sqrt(1−z)); applying Lagrange inversion to z=u(2−u) gives the stated coefficient and the neighboring ratio R_{n,k}=2(n−k)(k+2θ)/[k(2n−k−1)]. The ratio difference has a positive denominator and a numerator proportional to H_{n,k}, affine strictly increasing in θ since the θ coefficient is 2[(n−k)(2n−k)+k(n−1)]. At θ=−1/[2(n−1)], H factors as n(k−2)[k(n−2)+n]/(n−1); thus k=2 is the sole equality and below the boundary it is the failure witness. This covers all interior k, with no test for n=1,2, and yields the stated fixed-negative-strength size bound. An independently written exact-fraction recurrence replay found agreement over n=1–80, 554 strength/size cases and 66,909 checks, including the boundary and neighbors.
